{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Calculate conversion rate for email
email_conversion_rate = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()

# Calculate conversion rate for paid_search
paid_search_conversion_rate = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Calculate the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = email_conversion_rate - paid_search_conversion_rate

email_conversion_rate, paid_search_conversion_rate, difference"}
